item.title: Irish fishing groups condemn EU–Norway fisheries agreement
item.description: Ireland’s fishing industry has reacted with anger to a new EU–Norway fisheries deal. The Irish Fish Producers’ Organisation and the Killybegs Fishermen’s Organisation say the agreement heavily favours Norway. Norway will gain access to blue whiting worth about €21.5 million in waters off Ireland’s west coast.
